svg.title: Build Received date source order for every release and RC phase
svg.desc: Use the same Build Received source order for every release and every RC phase found. Try manual override, a successful matching Stage Promoter RC run, and the Product Pages schedule, with checked-in release-variable YAML filling missing milestones. If those sources give no valid date, search Jira Epics by release Fix Version and build-helper summary, without a project or initiative restriction. Let n be the RC number in the dashboard phase and match summaries containing RCn. Read resolutiondate from the matching Push to Stage Epic first; if missing or before Code Freeze, try the matching Prepare Epic. A Jira helper date after Test Started can still be used. Test Started comes separately from the RCn Builds Testing Epic's first In Progress transition. Return null if no source gives a valid date.
svg.text: Build Received sources for every release and RC phase

g.text: OPTIONAL OVERRIDE
ACTUAL_BUILD_DATES
Use the configured date for this release and RC phase, if present.
DATE FOUND → use it

svg.text: No date, or invalid date → continue

g.text: GITHUB ACTIONS
Successful matching Stage Promoter RC run
Match release and RC build type from the successful show-info job log.
Use latest eligible completion date; requires GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN.
DATE FOUND → use it

svg.text: No date, or invalid date → continue

g.text: SCHEDULE SOURCE
Product Pages; checked-in YAML fills missing fields
Use the matching Product Pages RC task when it has a date.
Otherwise use the RC milestone from the checked-in release-variable YAML, if present.
DATE FOUND → use it

svg.text: No date, or invalid date → continue

g.text: JIRA: CHECK THIS ONLY IF STEPS 1–3 HAVE NO VALID DATE
Match the phase RC number to Jira build Epics
Search Epics by release Fix Version and helper summary; no project or initiative filter.
Match the phase's RCn; read resolutiondate from its Push to Stage Epic first.
If missing or before Code Freeze, try the matching Prepare Epic's resolutiondate.
DATE FOUND → use it

svg.text: No valid date from any source

g.text: FINAL VALUE
when no source provides a valid date

svg.text: Skip candidates before known Code Freeze. A Jira date after Test Started can still be Build Received.
Test Started is separate: first In Progress transition on the RCn Builds Testing Epic.
